rule.description: postcss: PostCSS: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via improper escaping of style closing tags
rule.name: LanguageSpecificPackageVulnerability
rule.full_description: PostCSS takes a CSS file and provides an API to analyze and modify its rules by transforming the rules into an Abstract Syntax Tree. Versions prior to 8.5.10 do not escape `</style>` sequences when stringifying CSS ASTs. When user-submitted CSS is parsed and re-stringified for embedding in HTML `<style>` tags, `</style>` in CSS values breaks out of the style context, enabling XSS. Version 8.5.10 fixes the issue.
rule.help:
**Vulnerability CVE-2026-41305**
| Severity | Package | Fixed Version | Link |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|MEDIUM|postcss|8.5.10|[CVE-2026-41305](https://avd.aquasec.com/nvd/cve-2026-41305)|

PostCSS takes a CSS file and provides an API to analyze and modify its rules by transforming the rules into an Abstract Syntax Tree. Versions prior to 8.5.10 do not escape `</style>` sequences when stringifying CSS ASTs. When user-submitted CSS is parsed and re-stringified for embedding in HTML `<style>` tags, `</style>` in CSS values breaks out of the style context, enabling XSS. Version 8.5.10 fixes the issue.
